body:
1. Update lib/scheduler.mjs line 1348 branch error message: change '(agb merges into and resets the checked-out branch)' to '(agb advances ${base} by ref update; the checkout must match the base being advanced).'
2. Update lib/scheduler.mjs lines 956 & 1000+: log an advisory warning when recordGate or checkFlailDetector returns ok: false so audit gate degradation is visible.
3. Update lib/preflight.mjs line 33 JSDoc: clarify that gate failure returns ok: true with gateFailures populated for advisory logging.
4. Safeguard/clarify dormant reviewCalibration in lib/review.mjs.
5. Keep lib/lock.mjs line 97 lock verification guard as accepted defense-in-depth.

Verification: npm test
title: Fix scheduler branch error message, log degraded audit gates, and update preflight JSDoc
